name: GBCatalogSync
author: Chuck Zimmerheld
description: Pushes game-page changes to the giant-bomb-next catalog-sync endpoint. No-op unless enabled with a shared key.

GBCatalogSyncEnabled.description: Enable catalog-sync pushes. When false, hooks return immediately.

GBCatalogSyncKey.description: Shared secret sent as x-gb-internal-key (env WIKI_CATALOG_HOOK_KEY).

GBCatalogSyncEnforceUniqueGuid.description: Reject saves that point a game page at a guid another page already owns. Users with gbcatalogsync-guid-override are exempt. Independent of the push being enabled.
